name: NAMO Shree Scheme
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance Amount** Eligible women beneficiaries receive ₹12,000/- from conception to delivery of the child for their first two live children, distributed in phases.
> **Disbursal for First Pregnancy** - ₹5,000/- at the time of registration (₹2,000/- from State Government and ₹3,000/- from Central Government) - ₹2,000/- after six months of pregnancy (from the State Government
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be from Gujarat. 2. The applicant must be a pregnant woman or a lactating mother. 3. The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: - Scheduled Tribe - Scheduled Caste - Beneficiary of the National Food Security Act - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana Beneficiary - Below Poverty Line families - E Shram Card holder women beneficiary - Women who are farmers - Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act beneficiary 4. The applicant's family income must not be more than ₹8,00,000/- per year. 5. The applicant must deliver the child in any government or private hospital. 6. The applicant must register at the time of the first antenatal check-up.
